item.title: SunShine From Death - Films that can be hard to watch if someone you love died.
item.description:
(Films that can be hard to watch if you lost a brother/son.)

In 2016 my family lost my brother.
Since then we have watched some films that are just kind of hard to watch.

My family and I watched other films but I forgot some of them.

  • Breakthrough
  • A Question of Faith
  • Heaven Is for Real
  • I Still Believe
  • Let Go and Let God
  • Run the Race
  • King of Knives
  • Collateral Beauty
  • The Girl Who Believes in Miracles
